title: 观测器实现的输出反馈
caption: 离散确定性 Luenberger 观测器同时接收实际输入 u_t 与测量 y_t；以残差 y_t−C x̂_t 修正估计，再由 u_t=−K x̂_t 形成闭环。真实状态只进入测量映射，不直接供给反馈律。K 与 L 分别决定 A−BK 与 A−LC 的特征模态；这里不混入 Kalman 增益的随机更新。
brief: Scientific mechanism: deterministic DISCRETE-TIME linear plant with real state update x(next)=A x +B u and measurement y=C x. There is a state-estimate observer, whose update is xhat(next)=A xhat+B u+L(y−C xhat). Controller acts ONLY on the estimated state using u=−K xhat. Show four distinct modules: feedback law/controller, actual plant/state, measurement map, and observer. Essential directed edges: estimated state from observer into controller; controller output u branches to BOTH actual plant and observer; actual plant state goes only to measurement map; measured output from measurement map goes to observer. Do not send real state to the controller. Do not send estimated state to actual measurement. Show a clean closed feedback loop with unambiguous branches, no double-headed arrows and no phantom connections. Observer can be a spacious single pale-green module with reserved region for its full update formula and residual description; no need to explode into every scalar multiplication. Plant gets a large blank region for its true state equation; controller has blank region for its feedback formula; measurement module is small with blank formula region. Estimated and real paths visually distinguishable by restrained Green/Blue/Orange; continuous-time integrators in references are NOT applicable and must not be copied. No reference input, tracking setpoint, external noise, or Kalman filter: our specific model has none of these. No extra decorative icons are needed; if any, one per semantic module max.
